title: Intertitles
rule: A silent picture: pantomime panels alternate with ornate title cards carrying the lines.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome
build: films/swarm/99-ways/build/p95_intertitles.py (rest layers: kit/build_page01; Rol cutout and print grammar: kit/build_page04)

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

made: a main title card across the head: 'THE SERVICE KEY / A photoplay in one reel - Randolph station, Vermont, 1937' (jumping pen lettering of the rol-cutout kit, in cream on black)
twelve cells in a checkerboard read row by row: picture, card, picture, card ...; six pantomime pictures and six title cards

pictures: the 99-ways-template Rothstein rest layers recomposed WITHOUT balloons (P1 desk and memo; P5 under the tavern clock at 4:10; P8 open cupboard, key on its hook tagged SERVICE, pencil to chin; last shot P8 without the agent, irised in on the key and tag); the stranger is the Agence Rol 34852 woman (page 04's cutout) laid behind the TICKET OFFICE glass of rest layer P6, its gilt letters laid back over her; for the thanks the cutout is reversed and bowed
every picture toned and printed inside a black film gate with rounded corners and a light vignette, pasted with its shadow

title cards: HANDMADE black cards (LoC sheet fibre in the card) with a pen-drawn cream double rule, corner scrolls and lozenges; cards carry the memo (expository), the four canon lines in quotation marks, and the outcome with THE END
reel: His memo: | open the SERVICE door | at 4:15. The key is | in the cupboard.
"Pardon me — | have you the | right time?"
"Well, here I am... | and what for?"
The key stays on its hook; | the SERVICE door | stays closed. | THE END

events.E1: cell 3 picture (her at the glass) + cell 4 card (question)
events.E3: cell 7 picture (her bow, turning) + cell 8 card (thanks)
events.E5: cell 9 pose + cell 10 card (forgetting) + cell 11 iris on key + cell 12 card (outcome, THE END)

beat: the reel projected: the main title, then cells appear in reading order, picture then title card, two at a time
beat_frames: b07 + forgetting card, iris, THE END

self_check.check: No balloon appears; every line is on a title card between pictures.
self_check.evidence: by construction (panel_rest drops every b_ layer; no balloon code in the build) and by eye: each of the four line cards (cells 4, 6, 8, 10) has a picture before and after it
self_check.pending: independent blind reading not run by the maker

weaknesses: the stranger is the Rol 1913 woman (festive bonnet), not Bubley's figure, as on pages 04/73/78; the two lady shots are nearly the same picture
the first and last title cards are expository (memo, outcome) as well as the four line cards; the end card follows the last picture directly
the rest-layer agent keeps the white scissor margins of page 01's cutouts, which read as cutouts more than as film
the iris shot's key and SERVICE tag are small at phone width
